description: Fetches AP News articles and extracts structured content (title, byline, body, metadata) from apnews.com article URLs.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: 获取单篇文章内容; 需要 url 参数; 参数: url; 必填: 无
  - search: 搜索文章; 需要 query 参数; 参数: query, max_results; 必填: 无

url.description: AP News article URL (used by get_article function)

query.description: Search query for finding articles (used by search function)

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (used by search function)
